rationale: Average power drawn; combines load level and voltage (Assessment 1: current regimes).
Total voltage swing; summarises how deep the discharge went.
Drop from the starting voltage to the mean level; captures curve shape (voltage_std was a top-3 correlate).
Self-heating relative to the chamber; separates cell heating from the set-point.
Temperature rise per ampere; a rough proxy for internal resistance (I²R heating).
Compresses the right-skewed cycle count; early cycles are most informative about ageing.
